description: Single authoritative version/compatibility manifest for the rickgent trust-spine release. All npm, Python, CLI, build-identity, Omnigent-compatibility, toolchain, package-content, installer, runtime-path, and licensing values are generated or checked against this file. Packed installation is possible only when validate-release-manifest.mjs and assert-package-inventory.mjs both pass against this manifest.

build_identity.build_commit_format: 40-char lowercase hex git SHA; the literal "dev" is a build failure
build_identity.lag_by_one_note: The committed build-commit.ts intentionally references the parent of the amended HEAD; runtime parity is established by init.sh rebuilding dist to the current HEAD.

omnigent_compatibility.pin: omnigent is pinned at 0.6.0.dev0 (editable, read-only); exact commit pin is forbidden for the evolving contract; compatibility is proven by an offline behavioral probe, not a silent pin

npm.role: cli-only: the npm tarball ships the compiled CLI and its lockfile

python.role: pure-Python policy shims over the TypeScript verdict core

installer.description: install.sh assembles the full runtime: it installs (or locates) the compatible Omnigent, runs pnpm install + pnpm build for the orchestrator, pip-installs rickgent-policies, links the rickgent launcher onto PATH, and runs rickgent doctor as a behavioral gate. Agent bundles are resolved from the repository checkout during install; the installer records runtime lookup metadata.
installs: omnigent (compatible, editable or pinned per the omnigent compatibility contract)

assembly_plan.omnigent_source: external compatible dependency installed by the installer
assembly_plan.clean_packed_install_requirement: a clean packed installation contains or installs the CLI, agent bundles, Python policies, LICENSE, and runtime lookup metadata without repository-relative fallback; source-tree fallback makes the install invalid
